steps.message:
Add the following recipes into the Broccoli app:
title|description|servings|preparationTime|ingredients|directions
Butternut Squash Soup|A quick and easy meal, perfect for busy weekdays.|1 serving|20 mins|see directions|Sauté onions and garlic, add cubed butternut squash and broth. Puree until smooth and season with nutmeg, salt, and pepper. Garnish with fresh herbs for a more vibrant taste.
Execute: adb shell "pm list packages | grep -i broccoli; ls /data/data 2>/dev/null | grep -i broccoli; ls /sdcard/Android/data 2>/dev/null | grep -i broccoli"

arguments.command: python android_env.py adb "adb shell "pm list packages | grep -i broccoli; ls /data/data 2>/dev/null | grep -i broccoli; ls /sdcard/Android/data 2>/dev/null | grep -i broccoli""

steps.message: Execute: adb shell "ls -la /data/data/com.flauschcode.broccoli; ls -la /data/data/com.flauschcode.broccoli/databases 2>/dev/null; ls -la /data/data/com.flauschcode.broccoli/files 2>/dev/null; ls -la /data/data/com.flauschcode.broccoli/shared_prefs 2>/dev/null"

arguments.command: python android_env.py adb "adb shell "ls -la /data/data/com.flauschcode.broccoli; ls -la /data/data/com.flauschcode.broccoli/databases 2>/dev/null; ls -la /data/data/com.flauschcode.broccoli/files 2>/dev/null; ls -la /data/data/com.flauschcode.broccoli/shared_prefs 2>/dev/null""
python android_env.py adb "adb shell "am force-stop com.flauschcode.broccoli""
